name: OpenResearch
description: Turn your coding agents into research agents
one_liner: A tool that turns AI coding assistants like Claude Code into research assistants that read papers, form hypotheses, and help run experiments for you.
buyer: A PhD student or R&D team lead drowning in papers who wants an AI to help triage literature and draft experiment plans.
business_use_cases: A PhD researcher points it at a folder of PDFs to get an organized literature-review draft instead of manually reading a hundred papers.
A biotech or pharma R&D team uses it to generate and rank hypothesis candidates from published research before committing lab time.
A science-focused newsletter writer uses it to summarize and cross-reference new papers for weekly content.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a managed cloud-compute tier for teams who don't want to run local models (the project already sells this)
Build a vertical version tuned for one field, such as clinical-trials literature, and sell it to that niche

steal_this: Point it at your own field's last fifty papers this weekend, generate a literature-review draft, and post it publicly as proof it works, then use that as the pitch to sell a vertical version.
